    When: The page renders

Fixed shadow branch health status bug. Root cause: the daemon's /api/meta/shadow endpoint was passing ctx.shadow.worktreeDir (full absolute path like /home/user/project/.kspec) as the 'directory' option to getShadowStatus(), which expects just a directory name (like '.kspec'). getShadowStatus joins projectRoot + directory, so the full path produced an invalid path like /home/user/project//home/user/project/.kspec, causing all three health checks (branchExists, worktreeExists, worktreeLinked) to fail. Fix: use ctx.config.shadow.directory (the directory name from project config) instead. Added regression test verifying that passing a full path as directory produces unhealthy status.
